title: phaseolus vulgaris var. cardinalis
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. cardinalis, commonly known as Cardinal Kidney Bean, is a variety of the common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) plant. It is a nutrient-rich legume that offers various health benefits due to its high content of fiber, protein, and essential vitamins and minerals. The health benefits of Cardinal Kidney Bean include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, while its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cardinal Kidney Bean include polyphenols, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its potential therapeutic effects.
